content: Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔn
woodɑn kpɑkororu suɑm dɑ
Dɑfidi u kpɑm Isirelibɑn tɑbu durɔbu kpuro sokɑ u mɛnnɑ bɑ kuɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ (30.000).

Yerɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ kɑ win tɔn be kpuro bɑ dɑ Bɑlɑɔ Yudɑn temɔ bu kɑ Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu tɑmɑ. Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinnin yĩsirɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ tu soku, wi, wi u rɑ sinɛ ten wɔllɔ, wɔllun kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibun suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɑ tu suɑ bɑ doke nɑɑ kɛkɛ kpɑɑ ɡɑɑ sɔɔ bɑ kɑ doonɑ Abinɑdɑbun yɛnun di ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ. Usɑ kɑ Akiyo, Abinɑdɑbun bibu, berɑ bɑ nɑɑ kɛkɛ ye kpɑre.
Usɑ u wɑ̃ɑ yen yɛ̃sɑɔ, mɑ Akiyo u ye ɡbiiye bɑ kɑ dɔɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ bu swĩi bɑ mɔrɔkunu soomɔ, kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔɡenu kɑ bɑrɑ kpɑ̃nu kɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu kɑ yɑnkokonu. Mɑ bɑ womusu mɔ̀ bɑ yɑɑmɔ kɑ ben dɑm kpuro, bɑ kɑ Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ bɑ turɑ Nɑkonin doo soo yerɔ, yerɑ nɛɛ yi, yi sokurɑ. Mɑ kpɑkoro te, tɑ sikirɑmɑ, mɑ Usɑ u tu ɡɑbɑ.
Mii mii Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ nùn mɔru kuɑ. Mɑ u derɑ u wɔrumɑ kpɑkoro ten bɔkuɔ u ɡu, yèn sɔ̃ u tu bɑbɑ.
Dɑfidi u mɔru kuɑ too yèn sɔ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Usɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑ mɛ. Mɑ u yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Usɑn ɡoo yeru. Terɑ bɑ kɑ mu sokumɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ dɔmɑ te. Yerɑ n derɑ u kɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ u koo ko u kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te turi win yɛnuɔ.
Mɑ u ɡɔ̃ru doke u ku ɡinɑ kɑ tu dɑ win wuuɔ. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ kɑ tu dɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu Gɑtiɡiin yɛnuɔ.
Mɑ tɑ kuɑ mi suru itɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u durɔ wi kɑ win yɛnuɡibu domɑru kuɑ.
Bɑ kɑ kpɑkoro te nɑ
Yerusɑlɛmuɔ
Yen biru bɑ Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ win ye u mɔ kpuro domɑru kuɑ woodɑn kpɑkoro ten sɔ̃. Sɑɑ yerɑ Dɑfidi u dɑ u kpɑkoro te suɑmɑ u kɑ nɑ win wuuɔ kɑ nuku doo bɑkɑbu.
Tɔn be bɑ kpɑkoro te sɔɔwɑ mi, ye bɑ kuɑ nɑɑ dɑbusɑnu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ, yerɑ Dɑfidi u derɑ bɑ nɑɑ kinɛru kɑ nɑɑ kpɛmbu ɡe ɡɑ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡo bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Mɑ u seewɑ u yɑberu potɑ u yɑ̃ku kowon sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃nu ɡɑnu pɔrɑ sɛ̃ke mɑ u yɑɑmɔ bɑsi kɑ win dɑm kpuro Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Wi kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te suɑmɑ bɑ wee bɑ kuuki mɔ̀ kɑ nuku dobu mɑ bɑ kɔbi soomɔ.
Ye kpɑkoro te, tɑ duɔ Dɑfidin wuuɔ, mɑ Mikɑli, Sɔɔlun bii tɔn kurɔ u mɛɛrimɑ sɑɑ fɛnɛntin di u wɑ wee, Dɑfidi u yɔ̃ɔkumɔ u yɑɑmɔ kpɑkoro ten wuswɑɑɔ. Yerɑ u nùn ɡɛmɑ.
Ye bɑ kɑ kpɑkoro te tunumɑ, yerɑ bɑ tu doke ten ɑyerɔ kuu bekuruɡiru sɔɔ te Dɑfidi u kuɑ ten sɔ̃. Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kuɑ kɑ mɑɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu.
Ye u yɑ̃ku ni kuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ domɑru kuɑ kɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinnin yĩsiru.
Mɑ u be kpuro dĩɑnu bɔnu kuɑ tɔn kurɔbu kɑ tɔn durɔbu. U ben bɑɑwure pɛ̃ɛ kɑ yɑɑ wɔ̃ɔrɑ wɛ̃ kɑ sere mɑɑ kirɑ te bɑ kuɑ kɑ resɛm ɡbebɑ. Mɑ ben bɑɑwure u ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ win yɛnuɔ.

Dɑfidi u mɑɑ seewɑ u dɑ u kɑ win yɛnuɡibu tɔbiri. Yerɑ Mikɑli, Sɔɔlun bii tɔn kurɔ u yɑrimɑ u Dɑfidi sennɔ nɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑnnɑ ɑ ɡirimɑ wɑ ɡisɔ ye Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u kɑ tii kɑwɑ, u tii kɑkiɑ nɡe tɔn diro win bwɑ̃ɑbun yoo tɔn kurɔbun wuswɑɑɔ.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u Mikɑli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ wi u wunɛn tundo kɑ win yɛnuɡibu kpuro deri, mɑ u mɑn ɡɔsɑ n kɑ ko win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn kpɑro, wiyɑ nɑ yɑɑwɑ nɑ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Kon mɑɑ wure n de bu mɑn ɡɛm win sɔ̃ n mɛ kere, kpɑ n tii kɑwɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ ko nɑ n bɛɛrɛ mɔ bɑɑ kɑ yoo tɔn kurɔ ben wuswɑɑɔ.
N deemɑ Mikɑli, Sɔɔlun bii tɔn kurɔ wi, u ǹ bii mɑrure sere u kɑ ɡu.
